name: Reaper Farm rfBTC vault redeem without owner authorisation
summary: ReaperVaultV2 redeem(shares, receiver, owner) never verifies that the caller is owner or has the owner's share allowance, so the attacker burned arbitrary holders' rfBTC shares and sent the underlying BTC token to its receiver.
notes: Plain ReaperVaultV2 deployment; the 16,821-byte runtime is unchanged from creation through the exploit.
Three attacker transactions emitted 11 Withdraw events whose assets sum to exactly 9.69794911 BTC. Later third-party withdrawals sent remaining assets to Reaper's rescue safe and are excluded.
